findings.message: A2 claimed REMOVE 9x Herb patch network, but catalog still hosts the row on 9 regions: misthalin, karamja, asgarnia, kandarin, fremennik, forinthry, desert, morytania, tirannwn
Same regions carry BOTH global network and local Herb patches (N) rows — double-count risk in Build UI.
forinthry Herb patches (0) contradicts first-class Wilderness herb patch site row and network host membership. A2 script note said no standard herb patch; site row treats Wilderness as herb-run node.

asgarnia Herb patches (2) note cites Taverley + Falador; first-class Troll Stronghold disease-free herb patch is not reflected in the (2) total. Network detail still scores Falador + Trollheim for Asgarnia.
Local Herb patches (N) covers all 11 regions; global network only hosts 9 (missing havenhythe, anachronia).
regional-skilling-unlocks still has cross-region:herb-patch-network — likely re-sync source that reintroduced catalog multi-host copies after A2 remove.
